name: Meeting Notes
office_task: After each client meeting, file what the client told us (facts, preferences, standing instructions) on their record as suggestions, for a partner to accept or reject.
systems_of_record: the practice management system that issues the job_id and the client id on it (for example Xero Practice Manager or FYI)
the practice's client memory list on its own Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, with an approvals list only approvers can write to

emits.write: each fact, preference or standing instruction heard in the meeting note, filed as a proposed item on the client's memory list against the job_id the note names, with the note's message_id as its source and stated or inferred (naming the model) as said
emits.readback: the memory list returns an item id; reading that id back returns the client_id from the job, the job_id, source.ref equal to the message_id and status proposed. No id back, or any other status, means nothing was filed: an exception is raised and the run stops

emits.write: the monthly review: every approved standing instruction once, with its version, when it was last followed, and an ok, not_applied or contradicted flag with its evidence. It changes nothing on the list
emits.readback: the review list returns a report_id; reading it back returns the lines published. No id back raises memory.review_not_published

emits.write: an exception naming the practice manager: a decision from someone not on the approvers list or not from the approval surface, a note with no job id, an unreadable job, or a write that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id or decision id, the reason and the exception_owner
